story: Once upon a time, in a forest, there lived a fierce lion. Every day, he hunted many animals, and the animals were very scared. One day, all the animals gathered and made a plan. They went to the lion and said, “Please don’t hunt us every day. We will send one animal to you daily as food.” The lion agreed. Each day, one animal went to the lion. One day, it was a small rabbit’s turn. The rabbit walked slowly on purpose and reached the lion very late. The lion roared, “Why are you so late?” The rabbit said, “On the way, another lion stopped me. He said he is the real king of the forest.” The lion became very angry. “Take me to that lion!” he shouted. The rabbit led him to a deep well and said, “He lives inside here.” The lion looked into the well and saw his own reflection in the water. Thinking it was another lion, he roared loudly. The reflection roared back. In anger, the lion jumped into the well and fell inside. He could not escape. The animals were finally free and lived happily.
